title: Printed Different at Louder Than Life
paragraphs: Hey — I'm TheLitHippie420, the creator behind LitPrintz. When Laughing Dragons Productions built ltl26.com as an unofficial fan map and game hub for the fest, we teamed up so the band-logo mini-games could show off artwork that actually lives on real drinkware.

Every logo you see in the LTL Slider and Band Matcher games is custom LitPrintz art — the same vibe as our 3D-printed cooler coozies, interchangeable lids, and straw toppers. Nothing mass-produced off a shelf; each piece is designed, printed, assembled, and inspected in-house.

Playing the games is free (pick one on your first visit). If a logo stops you mid-setlist debate, you can order your own personal coozie with that artwork at LitPrintz.com — printed different, built for the pit.
